# DropSpace v0.3.0-beta.25 — Beta.24 full bug-fix pass

<!-- update-summary: Beta 25 is the complete remediation pass for the Beta.24 audit. It hardens Apple Music track identity and lyric matching/synchronization, bounded clipboard and drag/OLE lifetimes, batch persistence, native window recovery, updater integrity/cancellation, and release validation boundaries. -->

## Changes

- Lyrics now require candidate identity plus metadata validation before a result is accepted. Apple Music track identity, session revisions, timeline continuity, provider fallback, TTML/LRC/plain-text parsing, cache isolation, loading/error states, and expanded/compact rendering were tightened together.
- Clipboard capture and remote propagation now use bounded latest-event processing, durable commit ordering, atomic file batches, retryable cleanup, and isolated subscriber failures.
- File drops, virtual OLE files, multi-monitor geometry, XamlRoot recovery, batch paging, and media/audio fallback paths now fail closed or recover without stale UI ownership.
- Update downloads and installs now isolate waiter cancellation and report integrity, trust, state-persistence, launcher, and rollback failures as actionable states.
- The release and compatibility checks now use the current Beta naming and the 64-bit Windows build 20348 baseline.

## Upgrade compatibility

Beta.24 users can update to Beta.25 through the normal Beta channel. Existing SQLite data, app-owned payloads, settings, and historical Preview/Beta version parsing remain compatible. No schema migration is required for this bug-fix release.

## Known limits

This build requires x64 Windows build 20348 or later. The current development environment can build and run Core/Infrastructure tests but does not provide the Windows App SDK runtime needed by native WinUI smoke tests. Real Apple Music, Explorer/OLE, mixed-DPI, multi-monitor, lock/sleep, installer and deployed-update evidence remains a target-machine release gate.

Official website: https://airanluo-dot.github.io/DropSpace/
